summary: Genesis 3:7 names the fig tree as the source of leaves sewn into coverings. In Jeremiah 24:2 the same noun names the fruit gathered in baskets.

evidence.note: עֲלֵה תְאֵנָה identifies the leaves sewn into coverings by the tree they came from.
The one who tends a תְּאֵנָה eats its fruit, distinguishing the tree from what it bears.

senses.definition: The edible fruit of the fig tree.

evidence.note: One basket contains good figs like early ripe figs, and the other contains figs too bad to eat.
